whatsNewDesc: Markasso Cloud and the Mac app are here.
whatsNewCloud: Your boards in sync between the web and the Mac, and AI agents drawing with you live. 5 € a month or 48 € a year, no account.
whatsNewMac: The native app: real documents, Quick Look, tabs and automatic updates. Free.
whatsNewLeave: ⋯ More tools → Leave live session, whenever you want: the board stays with you.
cloudMenuNote: Save and sync your boards between the web and the Mac with Markasso Cloud.

cloudDetailReadOnly: You can view this board. Duplicate it to make your own copy.
cloudDetailOffline: Your changes stay here and upload as soon as you are back online.

cloudLicenseNeeded: Saving to the cloud needs a Markasso Cloud licence. Paste your key to continue.
cloudKeyStored: A cloud licence key is stored in this browser.

cloudWelcomeKey: Your licence key is in the Polar customer portal: open it from your purchase email or from the link below, then paste the key in menu > Cloud licence.
macPagePitch: The same fast, keyboard-first whiteboard, as a native Mac app.
macPageFacts: Free · Apple Silicon and Intel · macOS 26 or later
macPageNotarized: Markasso isn't notarized yet: the first time, allow it in System Settings > Privacy & Security > Open Anyway.
macPageShotAlt: Markasso for Mac with the assistant panel and the shape library
macPageDocs: .markasso files as real documents: Finder, iCloud Drive, autosave and versions
macPageQuickLook: Quick Look previews and Spotlight search
macPageNative: Native menus and shortcuts, tabs, Handoff, Share and Print
macPageCloud: Cloud boards synced with the web, offline edits and conflict resolution (with Markasso Cloud, the same licence as the web)
macPageAssistant: An assistant preview with your own Anthropic or OpenAI key or a local model, which you can turn off
macPageStep1: Download and open the zip, then drag Markasso.app to Applications.
macPageStep2: Open it once: macOS says it cannot verify the developer.
macPageStep3: Open System Settings > Privacy & Security, scroll to the message about Markasso and click Open Anyway. Confirm with your password or Touch ID.
macPageStep4: From then on it opens normally, and updates install themselves (Markasso > Check for Updates).
